title: Resolved tenant entitlement response
description: Entitlement lookup MUST resolve only for an active, unrevoked, unexpired API key whose persisted scopes remain a non-empty unique subset of the provider's current allowlist. Empty, malformed, duplicate, unsupported, or retired scopes MUST fail closed with the same non-disclosing response as an unknown or inactive key. API-key and entitlement lookup MUST row-lock the matching key in a serializable transaction before evaluating active, revocation, expiry, or current-scope state. Expiry MUST be evaluated with a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock after the lock and rechecked after response validation immediately before COMMIT; unknown, inactive, concurrently revoked, expired, or invalid-scope keys MUST fail closed without disclosure. Entitlement lookup MUST also row-lock the resolved organization entitlement before response validation.

organization_id.description: Every persisted organization_id resolved from an API key, entitlement, active membership, or completed CLI session MUST be a non-empty, at-most-255-character, exact NFC-normalized Unicode-scalar string without surrounding whitespace, Unicode C0/C1 control characters, Unicode line or paragraph separators, Unicode format or bidirectional controls, Unicode noncharacter code points, or Unicode private-use code points. Malformed or noncanonical organization identifiers from an API-key row MUST fail closed immediately after that row lock and before key activity evaluation or entitlement access. Malformed or noncanonical active-membership or completed-session organization identifiers MUST fail closed immediately after their row lock and before CLI session access, membership access, tenant-quota or API-key access, response emission, persistence mutation, or COMMIT; providers MUST NOT normalize, trim, sanitize, coerce, or disclose them.

max_requests.description: Entitlement limits MUST be non-negative safe JSON integers no greater than 9007199254740991; providers MUST fail closed instead of rounding larger persisted BIGINT values.

max_tokens.description: Entitlement limits MUST be non-negative safe JSON integers no greater than 9007199254740991; providers MUST fail closed instead of rounding larger persisted BIGINT values.

max_api_keys.description: Maximum concurrently active, unrevoked, unexpired API keys permitted for the organization. Key creation MUST be denied when the current count is greater than or equal to this limit. After acquiring the per-tenant key-creation serialization lock, the provider MUST row-lock the resolved organization entitlement before reading max_api_keys or counting active keys; a concurrent entitlement change MUST block, retry, or fail serialization instead of permitting a decision from an unlocked stale limit. The active-key count MUST evaluate expiry after acquiring the per-tenant key-creation serialization lock, using a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock in the same transaction; transaction-start timestamps and service-process clock comparisons are forbidden. The limit and active count MUST remain lossless across persistence, aggregation and JSON serialization for the full safe-integer range. This value MUST be a non-negative safe JSON integer no greater than 9007199254740991; providers MUST fail closed instead of rounding a larger persisted BIGINT value.
